[Decision](https://github.com/franklesniak/PSStyleGuide/blob/33b95c196e5e9176c08572509997d21adf9904c0/docs/planning/action-items-2026-10-02/results/A06/PS-TF68-carryback/round1-recovery-findings/R3-npm-environment-duplication.md)

nodes.body: This npm-environment sanitization block appears multiple times in the workflow (e.g., in the verification, install, and dependency-tree steps). Duplicating this logic increases the chance of future drift (one step updated while others aren’t). Consider moving the sanitization into a single repo-owned helper script (bash) that each step calls, or using a single step that exports the sanitized env values and a reusable command wrapper, so policy changes stay consistent across all npm invocations.

+        run: |
+          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
+          if (Test-Path Variable:PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference) {
+              $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
+          }
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GITHUB_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GH_TOKEN) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: a token was projected into a code job'
+          }
+          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_COUNT) -or
+              -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS)) {
+              throw 'credential-policy: external Git command configuration is not allowed'
+          }
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM = '1'
+          $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = '/dev/null'
+          $env:GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT = '0'
+          $strDigestSource = 'copilot-setup-steps.yml retained runtime digest'
+          if ($env:TOOLCHAIN_LAYOUT -ceq 'legacy') {
+              $strVersion = '20.20.2'
+              $strReviewedSha256 = 'DF770B2A6F130ED8627C9782C988FDA9669FA23898329A61A871E32F965E007D'
+          } elseif ($env:TOOLCHAIN_LAYOUT -ceq 'modern') {
+              if (Test-Path -LiteralPath '.github/workflows/ci-toolchain.json') {
+                  $objRuntimePin = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath '.github/workflows/ci-toolchain.json' | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
+                  $objPackage = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'package.json' | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
+                  $strVersion = $objPackage.engines.node
+                  $strReviewedSha256 = $objRuntimePin.linuxX64Sha256.ToUpperInvariant()
+                  $strDigestSource = 'package.json engines.node and .github/workflows/ci-toolchain.json linuxX64Sha256'
+              } else {
+                  # Preserve service setup for published branches from before the shared declaration.
+                  $objPackage = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'package.json' | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
+                  $strVersion = $objPackage.engines.node
+                  if ($objPackage.engines.npm -cne '11.16.0') {
+                      throw 'toolchain: unsupported pre-declaration npm version'
+                  }
+                  switch -CaseSensitive ($strVersion) {
+                      '24.18.0' {
+                          $strReviewedSha256 = '55AA7153F9D88F28D765FCDAD5AE6945B5C0F98A36881703817E4C450FA76742'
+                      }
+                      '24.18.1' {
+                          $strReviewedSha256 = 'D6C664DF3F3F61458E8C277585571328522D705166723A7C7823A9253A4D15A0'
+                      }
+                      default {
+                          throw 'toolchain: a current runtime declaration is required'
+                      }
+                  }
+              }
+              if ($strVersion -cnotmatch '^24\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' -or
+                  $strReviewedSha256 -cnotmatch '^[A-F0-9]{64}$') {
+                  throw 'toolchain: the reviewed runtime declaration is invalid'
+              }
+          } else {
+              throw 'toolchain: unsupported validation-tool layout'
+          }
+          $strNodeRoot = [IO.Path]::Combine($env:RUNNER_TEMP, 'agent-validation-node')
+          $strArchive = [IO.Path]::Combine($env:RUNNER_TEMP, 'agent-validation-node.tar.xz')
+          if ([IO.Path]::Exists($strNodeRoot) -or [IO.Path]::Exists($strArchive)) {
+              throw 'toolchain: runtime staging destination already exists'
+          }
+          $strCurlPath = @('/usr/bin/curl', '/bin/curl') |
+              Where-Object { [IO.File]::Exists($_) } | Select-Object -First 1
+          $strTarPath = @('/usr/bin/tar', '/bin/tar') |
+              Where-Object { [IO.File]::Exists($_) } | Select-Object -First 1
+          if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($strCurlPath) -or [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($strTarPath)) {
+              throw 'toolchain: fixed download/extraction tools are unavailable'
+          }
+          $strUrl = "https://nodejs.org/dist/v$strVersion/node-v$strVersion-linux-x64.tar.xz"
+          & $strCurlPath --disable --silent --show-error --fail --location --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 120 --retry-max-time 300 --output $strArchive $strUrl
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "toolchain: download exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
+          if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $strArchive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -cne $strReviewedSha256) {
+              throw "toolchain: official Node archive does not match the reviewed digest for $strUrl. Check $strDigestSource. Verify the official release checksum before changing the declaration."
+          }
+          [void][IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($strNodeRoot)
+          & $strTarPath -xJf $strArchive -C $strNodeRoot --strip-components=1
+          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "toolchain: extraction exited $LASTEXITCODE" }
+          $strNodePath = [IO.Path]::Combine($strNodeRoot, 'bin', 'node')
+          $strNpmPath = [IO.Path]::Combine($strNodeRoot, 'bin', 'npm')
+          if (-not [IO.File]::Exists($strNodePath) -or -not [IO.File]::Exists($strNpmPath)) {
+              throw 'toolchain: verified runtime executables are missing'
+          }
+          $arrVersionOutput = @(& $strNodePath --version)
+          $intVersionExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
+          if ($intVersionExitCode -ne 0) {
+              throw "toolchain: runtime version command exited $intVersionExitCode"
+          }
+          if ($arrVersionOutput.Count -ne 1) {
+              throw 'toolchain: runtime version command must return exactly one line'
+          }
+          $strObservedVersion = $arrVersionOutput[0].Trim()
+          if ($strObservedVersion -cne "v$strVersion") {
+              throw 'toolchain: verified runtime executable identity is wrong'
+          }
+          [IO.File]::AppendAllText($env:GITHUB_PATH,
+              [IO.Path]::Combine($strNodeRoot, 'bin') + "`n", [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+
+      - name: Verify selected Node.js runtime
+        timeout-minutes: 2
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
+          GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
+          GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
+          TOOLCHAIN_LAYOUT: ${{ steps.toolchain.outputs.layout }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [[ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ||
+            -n "${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN:-}" || -n "${GIT_CONFIG_COUNT:-}" ||
+            -n "${GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS:-}" ]]; then
+            echo '::error::Unexpected credential or Git configuration channel.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
+          # env includes inherited names that are not valid Bash identifiers.
+          npm_environment=(/usr/bin/env)
+          while IFS= read -r -d '' entry; do
+            variable=${entry%%=*}
+            if [[ "${variable,,}" == npm_config_* ]]; then
+              npm_environment+=(-u "${variable}")
+            fi
+          done < <(/usr/bin/env -0)
+          # Wait for this process substitution before running any other child.
+          if ! wait "$!"; then
+            echo '::error::Unable to read the package-manager environment.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          export npm_config_userconfig=/dev/null
+          export npm_config_globalconfig=/etc/npmrc-absent-by-policy
+          npm_environment+=(-- "npm_config_userconfig=${npm_config_userconfig}"
+            "npm_config_globalconfig=${npm_config_globalconfig}")
+          if [[ ! -c "${npm_config_userconfig}" || -s "${npm_config_userconfig}" ||
+            -e "${npm_config_globalconfig}" || -L "${npm_config_globalconfig}" ]]; then
+            echo '::error::Unexpected package-manager configuration source.'
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          printf '%s\n' 'npm_config_userconfig=/dev/null' \
+            'npm_config_globalconfig=/etc/npmrc-absent-by-policy' >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
+          if [[ "${TOOLCHAIN_LAYOUT}" == modern ]]; then
+            expected_node="$(node -p 'require("./package.json").engines.node')"
+            expected_npm="$(node -p 'require("./package.json").engines.npm')"
+            test "$(node --version)" = "v${expected_node}"
+            test "$("${npm_environment[@]}" npm --version)" = "${expected_npm}"
